title: All About Butterflies
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — non-fiction, Phonics Screening Check review week, real facts about butterflies.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling looking up at a colourful orange-and-black butterfly fluttering just above long green grass.
A small green caterpillar crawling along a leaf, surrounded by long green grass.
A small green caterpillar munching steadily along the edge of a green leaf.
A plump, longer green caterpillar resting on a thick green stem.
A green caterpillar hanging still, enclosed inside a smooth, pale green case.
A faint outline of folded wings visible through the thin wall of a pale green case.
A pale green case splitting open as a butterfly slowly climbs out, its wings damp and folded.
A butterfly resting with bright, patterned orange-and-black wings open and drying in sunlight.
A butterfly landing gently on a bright flower among long green grass.
Ned the duckling watching happily as a butterfly rests on a bright flower.
